newsitem.title: USA: Mar/Apr Brent up, Apr Brent down in late US trade.
newsitem.headline: Mar/Apr Brent up, Apr Brent down in late US trade.

text.p: The March/April paper Brent spread climbed while the flat April Brent price eased in late U.S. trading on Wednesday, traders said.
March/April changed hands at 50 and 51 cents a barrel, up about 10 cents from earlier today.
"There was definitely a lack of sellers on that one," an East Coast trader said.
Four partial April Brents traded, three at $20.60 a barrel, and one at $20.62 a barrel, down two to four cents from the IPE settlement of $20.64 a barrel. A total of 375 lots were dealt.
Activity was slow since many traders were still attending IP Week industry activities in London.
